# QuadrupedSkeleton

**Tags:** `skeleton`

Four-legged skeleton (fore and hind legs, spine, neck, head, tail). Shared rig for mounts, domesticated creatures, and quadruped monsters.

> **Goal:** Provide a rig for quadruped creatures and mounts
